exact.先把身体弹出去再想办法。弹力高，控制较低。: Launch the body first, think later. High spring, lower control.
exact.看清风拍再收缩。控制高，落点更容易修正。: Read the wind beat, then contract. High control makes the landing easier to correct.
exact.慢慢弹，也能一直弹。耐力与黏性高，初始弹力较低。: Bounce slowly, but bounce for a long time. High endurance and grip, lower starting spring.
exact.弹力 +1、控制 -1。亮得像一小段刹车灯。: Spring +1, control -1. Bright as a short stretch of brake light.
exact.控制 +1、弹力 -1。冷静，但不是没有弹性。: Control +1, spring -1. Calm, but not without bounce.
exact.耐力 +1、黏性 -1。把灯光存进身体里。: Endurance +1, grip -1. Store the lamp light inside the body.
exact.黏性 +1、耐力 -1。更容易挂住灯柱，也更容易黏住同伴。: Grip +1, endurance -1. Easier to hang on a post — and to stick to a companion.
exact.灯柱还密，风在屋檐之间试探。: The posts are still close. Wind tests itself between the eaves.
exact.街面变快，灯柱间距拉开，风开始横着走。: The street speeds up, the gaps widen, and the wind starts to cut sideways.
exact.最后一段架在天上。能看见更远，也必须跳得更准。: The last stretch is up in the sky. You can see farther, and you have to jump truer.
exact.性格与颜色会真实改变物理属性；同性格同伴只是确定性的离线事件。: Nature and color truly change the physics. A same-nature companion is only a deterministic offline event.

exact.力度改变初速度与体力消耗；角度改变抛物线；输入与风拍的差值修正落点。动作 det: Power changes launch speed and stamina cost; angle changes the arc; the gap between your timing and the wind beat corrects the landing. The action detail already computes this beat's result.
exact.当前没有合法动作。: There is no legal action right now.
exact.力度决定基础贡献；与提示合拍有额外进度且不增额外拉力。超过需求太多也会拉紧。成功: Power sets the base contribution. Hitting the cue adds extra progress without extra tension. Overshooting the need also tightens tension. Success grants 2 blooms and a ward for the next jump.
exact.一颗果冻在路灯下醒来 · 先选性格: A jelly wakes under a lamp · pick a nature first
exact.这次死亡同时满足“体力归零”和“跳跃失误”。高力度耗体力更快；体力不足时应先 r: This death met both “stamina at zero” and “a missed jump.” High power drains stamina faster. When stamina is low, rest first instead of leaving the last jump to a miss.
exact.最后一次摔落发生在救援副本。救援不仅看进度，还要看拉力；超过需求太多也会增加拉力: The last fall happened in a rescue. Rescue is not only progress; tension matters too. Overshooting the need also raises tension.
exact.还没有跳跃失误或训练记录。先比较间距、角度、风拍与动作 detail，再记录这一: No missed jumps or training notes yet. Compare the gap, the angle, the wind beat, and the action detail, then record what this street actually did.
exact.把本局的性格、颜色、训练、最远关卡、最后一次跳跃的三档与落点误差写进你自己的 m: Write this run's nature, color, training, farthest level, and the last jump's three inputs and landing error into memory. If there was a rescue, also note progress and tension. Treat these as observations for this seed and this build. After the map, size, or stats change, test again — do not treat a fixed input as a universal guide.
exact.四十五根灯柱，把果冻跳到天亮: Forty-five lamp posts. Leap the jelly into daylight.
exact.一颗像史莱姆的果冻小生物，沿着不断延伸的街道跳过一根根灯柱。性格与颜色塑造弹力、: A slime-like jelly leaps lamp post to lamp post along a street that keeps extending. Nature and color shape spring, control, endurance, and grip. Each discrete jump is power, angle, and timing. Every fifteen clears you grow. An offline same-nature companion may stick to a post; rescuing them yields blooms and a ward.
exact.先选 nature:bold|steady|mellow，再选 color:co: Pick nature:bold|steady|mellow, then color:coral|mint|amber|lilac. --content bold:coral starts already shaped.
exact.jump:<low|mid|high>:<flat|arc|high>:<ear: jump:<low|mid|high>:<flat|arc|high>:<early|on|late> is power, angle, and timing, in that order.
exact.动作 detail 公开预计落点、误差和结果；next 是当前推荐。合法但预测会: The action detail publishes the predicted landing, error, and result. next is the current suggestion. A legal jump that is predicted to miss still resolves for real — it is not an illegal action.
exact.rest 回体力并推进风拍。精准落地攒灯花，train:<spring|cont: rest restores stamina and advances the wind beat. Clean landings bank blooms. train:<spring|control|endurance|grip> spends 3 blooms.
exact.街图在 state.street 累积延伸；关数提高视野、街速与间距。通关 15: The street in state.street keeps extending. Level raises view distance, street speed, and gap. You grow at 15 and 30 clears.
exact.同性格同伴是确定性的离线事件，不联网。黏连时用 rescue:<力度>:<时机>: A same-nature companion is a deterministic offline event, not a network. When stuck, use rescue:<power>:<timing>. Progress, tension, and remaining beats are public.
exact.第 45 关落地获胜。摔落到上限、力竭失误或救援最后坠落会输；recap 给出具: Landing level 45 is a win. Hitting the fall cap, missing while exhausted, or falling on the last rescue beat is a loss. The recap names the level, the action, and the error.
